design_notes: Emotion stories are 20 one-sentence stories per emotion about a character named Alex, generated by claude-sonnet-4-6 with 10_generate_stimuli.py; each shows the emotion without naming it, in under 20 words, and is set in one of the listed topics (sentence i uses the same topic for every emotion). The 5-per-emotion held-out set (emotions_heldout) is generated the same way on the remaining topics, so each topic appears once per emotion across both sets. Neutral baselines are 15 flat, factual stories across the first 15 listed topics. Neutral filler turns are unrelated topics, fixed and identical across all conditions, used to bridge measurement turns in the persistence/decay experiment.
